C1480.title: Research on Identity, Crime, and Law Enforcement in the Metaverse
C1480.summary: A 2025 study in Humanities and Social Sciences Communications examined identity systems, forms of crime, and law-enforcement challenges in the metaverse. It noted that cross-platform virtual identities, avatars, and digital assets may be misused or stolen, while anonymity, overlapping jurisdictions, and differences in platform evidence retention complicate attribution, legal responsibility, and cross-border investigations.
